subject: Endpoint evaluation matrix + cost/quality snapshot
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Endpoint evaluation matrix: initial data and ask

Team —

I pulled together an initial evaluation matrix comparing our top three short-list vendors (MDM, EDR, vuln scanner) across the dimensions we discussed in last week's security sync: cost (TCO over 12/24 months), detection/coverage estimates (internal scoring), integration lift, and renewal windows. The CSV attached has vendor-level rows plus a per-workload cost model (SaaS seat vs. dedicated nodes).

Ask: please review columns marked "VERIFY" (red) and add any empirical data you have (SOC2 report date, current discounts, renewal cutoff). Also flag any hard constraints we should bake into the procurement timeline (e.g., existing license end-dates we can't change).

High level observations in the sheet:
- Vendor A (SentinelEdge) has a higher list price but strong vulnerability coverage and a decent EDR signal-to-noise rating in our last pentest.
- Vendor B has the most attractive per-seat TCO but requires heavier engineering work for rollout.
- Vendor C is cheapest for MDM, but EDR feature parity is shaky.

Attachment: endpoint-eval-matrix-v1.csv

I'll consolidate feedback by Tuesday (23rd) and propose a staggered renewal plan (prioritize renewals where we get best unit-economics and lowest ops lift).

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

1) SentinelEdge looks like the best candidate on detection coverage for our high-risk workloads but has higher list cost. Claire provided SOW and pricing; SOC2 & pentest artifacts are inbound.
2) We have the auto-renew subset that expires 2026-09-15 — Procurement recommends a staged renewal: first contract (pilot + core 14k endpoints) effective 2026-08-01, followed by optional expansion 2027-02-01 to cover seasonal hires.
3) Deadline: Procurement needs vendor-complete questionnaire + final commercial terms by 2026-07-07 to secure the FY27 discount. If vendor misses that window, re-evaluate on cost basis.
4) Sean (finance): please confirm budget holdback process and whether we can table a small early-commit credit to get better pricing.

I will collate updated matrix (v2) with the vendor SOC2 date, confirmed seat def, and the proposed staggered timeline by EOD Friday and share with Exec for approval.
